candidate_count_provenance: Prior Phase 3 candidate inventory: 250/250 primary 60-node sampled requests had exactly two policy-valid plans
comparison: online sequential, no lookahead, fixed prior admissions
failure_scenarios: normal plus every unique single physical-link failure
capacity: independent per-direction full-duplex integer Mb/s with configurable fractional headroom
greedy: Phase3 first feasible from shortest working-hop sorted policy candidates
cspf: shortest working hops among robust feasible policy candidates; normal arc congestion tie-break
milp: one incoming request; min worst scenario directed arc utilization with exactly one plan selected, not future-optimal
milp_solver: SciPy optimize.milp (HiGHS), optimal status required; labelled greedy fallback otherwise
